articles.title: Tom Lee predicts ether will hit $250,000 as corporate validators take over network control
articles.snippet: The Bitmine chairman said DeFi and AI could push the Ethereum network's value into the multi-trillion range, making current prices “future optionality at a discount”.

articles.title: CFTC chair claims Gemini case was politically motivated, seeks to reverse $5M settlement
articles.snippet: The CFTC chair seeks to roll back an enforcement action on the company founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, donors to Donald Trump’s 2024 campaign and attendees at White House events.

articles.title: Florida Sues OpenAI, Sam Altman Over ChatGPT Safety Claims
articles.snippet: Florida's attorney general seeks damages, restrictions on ChatGPT, and personal liability for OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in what the state describes as the first state-led lawsuit against the AI company.

articles.title: Binance Opens Access to 7,000 US Stocks, Prepares Tokenized 'bStocks' Rollout
articles.snippet: Binance opened equities trading and previewed "bStocks," with experts split over whether tokenization unlocks growth or layers on new risk.
